extraction_query: Extract design and operational constraints evidenced in executable code or the graph. A constraint is a limit, compliance requirement, integration boundary, ambiguous area, or coverage gap — not a business rule the application enforces at runtime. Compare executable guards with usage/help text and comments: when an argument count, CSV field count, threshold, or accepted value disagrees, record the enforced guard as the current behavior and the mismatch as an ambiguity or defect. Preserve at-least, at-most, exactly, greater-than, and less-than semantics; never convert a `< 20` rejection into an exactly-five requirement. For each constraint state the constraint statement, origin, impact, and whether resolution is needed.
